metadata.title: Ambient Weather WS-5000 - Identify Sensor Gen

introduction: This guide will help you identify the generation of your temperature sensor.

steps.title: Ambient Weather WS-5000 - Identify Sensor Gen
steps.text:
Identify the connection between the Thermo-Hygrometer sesnor and the body of the array.
The 1st Generation of array does NOT have a removable sensor. It is covered in a white glue.
The 2nd and 3rd Generation DO have removable sensor chips. You will see a small black ring, which is the bottom of the sensor mount.

Remove the screws attaching the Solar Radiation Shield to the body of the array.
Remove Solar Radiation Shield fins and set aside.

Identify which Generation of Chip the array has.
The 1st Generation is NOT removable, and the entire array will need to be replaced.
The 2nd Generation IS removable, however, the chip is not replaceable. The entire array will need to be replaced.
The 3rd Generation IS removable, and replaceable. A new chip should get the unit up and running again.

conclusion.text: You should now be able to identify the generation of the component.
